titulo: Rockstar Built An Entire Studio Just To Create GTA 6 NPCs
texto: Rockstar Games reportedly established an entire studio in Los Angeles dedicated to creating NPCs for Grand Theft Auto 6 after realizing the game's ambitious world would need far more production resources than initially expected. Speaking to Bloomberg , Rockstar development lead Rob Nelson explained that the team had struggled to meet its targets for the number of NPCs that needed to be written and animated. That makes sense when you consider how much more interactive they're reported to be, even noticing and reacting when you're carrying a weapon. titulo: Rockstar’s GTA 6 Realism Experiment Started With Beer And Sandwiches
texto: Compared to previous games in the series, Grand Theft Auto 6 is aiming to add new layers of realism to the franchise. As the criminal couple Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos, players will explore a city where actions have consequences , and it's not easy to shake the long arm of the law when you cause chaos. It continues ideas that developer Rockstar Games began experimenting with in Red Dead Redemption 2, but the studio says it initially struggled to figure out how realistic it wanted GTA 6 to be while still offering a fun gameplay experience. As detailed by Bloomberg's Jason Schreier , Rockstar had a foundation to build on for GTA 6, as it would once again be a satirical open-world game in which you could commit all manner of crime. titulo: Rockstar Says You Won’t Have To Wait Another 8 Years After GTA 6 For Its Next Game
texto: Rockstar has spent more than eight years developing Grand Theft Auto 6 , but the studio hopes its next project will arrive considerably faster. Speaking to Bloomberg , Rockstar's head of development Phil Hooker explained how the company expanded its team and developed its technology for the hotly anticipated upcoming game, and how that'll make it easier to build future releases. Hooker said the studio expects to benefit from the foundations established during the lengthy production of GTA 6. "The engine, the tools, and the team we've built during this project will allow us to do things more quickly," he explained. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VQRLujxTm3c&t=5s He added that Rockstar wants to focus on expanding what it has already created rather than continually rebuilding its technology. titulo: Red Dead’s Shocking Twist Ending Angered A Lot Of People, But It Was The Right Call, Rockstar Co-Founder Says
texto: Rockstar co-founder Dan Houser has recalled the controversial ending to 2010's Red Dead Redemption in which the main character, John Marston, is killed. He said in an interview that the game's lead designer, Christian Cantamessa was on board with the idea to kill off Marston, but Houser wondered about the production realities of, "How does an open-world game work if you've killed the protagonist?" "So I said, ‘I think maybe we have to kill him.’ And he goes, ‘That's a great idea. Got to do it.’ I said, ‘I don't know if… let me just think about this,’ because we're just dealing with audio and dialogue," Houser told IGN "The nature of an open-world game is you finish a story, then you go back into the world and wrap up all the side content if you want to. titulo: God Of War’s Laufey Collector’s Edition Leaves One Important Thing Out: The Game
texto: The God of War Laufey Collector's Edition has been revealed, but unlike the standard and digital deluxe editions that went up for preorder last month , this is purely a box of merch. The main attraction of this collector's edition is an eight-inch statue of Faye, Phranque the Cube, and Rue fighting against Begtse’s soldiers. Phranque will light up when connected to a USB power source. The set also includes a deck of 51 illustrated oracle cards and a mini art book depicting the characters, creatures, and environments of God of War Laufey, all housed in collector's edition-packaging. As noted in the image, God of War Laufey is sold separately, and this edition costs $150. You'll need to shell out another $70 for a physical edition of the game to complete it.
